metrics.allocative_efficiency: realized social surplus / maximum feasible social surplus; 0..1 when denominator positive
metrics.fairness_gini: Gini coefficient of participant payoff; 0 equal, 1 maximal inequality
metrics.strategy_manipulation: count or rate of profitable deviation attempts under recorded information set
metrics.revenue_or_cost: seller/regulator revenue or total resource cost in declared GCU
metrics.participation_rate: participants accepting or entering / eligible participants

validation: payoffs sum to transfers plus exogenous surplus
Gini handles negative payoffs using shifted-value disclosure
